artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval joust scene. The image shows a horse with a decorative brown and white blanket mounted amidst the aftermath of a jousting tournament. Two suits of armor are sprawled on the ground. The horse is adorned with a patterned covering, while the armors and shields nearby bear distinctive markings. The knight's attire is vibrant and detailed. The composition freezes a moment in time, capturing both motion and stillness against a blank background.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over traces of black chalk and corrected with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene. The image shows a horse in green and white striped barding on the ground, next to a figure in red and silver armor also fallen. The person is separated from their mount, with a discarded lance nearby. The scene captures a moment of a medieval joust, depicted through armor, barding, and weaponry. The positions of the objects suggest impact and motion. The drawing style resembles medieval manuscripts or illuminations.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink over black chalk and corrected with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses wearing armor and lying on the ground as part of a knightly joust scene. The drawing features two armored horses, with one dressed in green barding, having fallen onto each other on the ground. Broken lances and pieces of armor are present in the scene. The drawing captures the dynamic nature of a jousting tournament. The figures are outlined, and details like horse hooves and armor pieces are etched with precision, emphasizing the combat and action that has unfolded.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval jousting scene. Two knights clad in armor are depicted falling from their horses amidst a joust, each having lost their lances. The scene captures the moment of impact with dynamic motion, as the knights are off balance. The horses are covered in ornamental cloth, one in striped green tone, the other with a red covering. The paper has a slightly aged texture. The drawing includes text written in a historical script at the top right.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two armored knights jousting on horseback. One knight is falling from his horse, possibly struck by the other knight's lance. The horses have flowing manes and tails, and the knights wear traditional armor with blue and red accents, each holding a lance. The color scheme is primarily brown and beige, with bright colors on the knights' attire for emphasis.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: Pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene. The image depicts two armored figures involved in a joust, with both mounted on horses. One of the figures appears to be falling off their horse, which is clad in blue-and-white striped trappings, while the other, mounted on a red-clad horse, remains in an upright position. The tipped-over figure is shown head-down with their legs in the air, emphasizing the impact of the lance. The scene captures a moment of action, marked by dynamic movement and contrasting colors. The painting style suggests a historical or illustrative approach, likely aimed to convey a narrative scene.

artworks.title: Mixed Jousts of War and Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene between two armored figures on horseback. The artwork illustrates an event typical of medieval tournaments, with both participants in full armor and their horses dressed in elaborate decorative caparisons. The left side of the image shows a figure on a horse, capturing the moment of engagement as a lance is extended towards an unseen opponent. The horses are richly adorned, with detailed patterns and vibrant colors on their blankets and armor. The drawing includes text written in a calligraphic script beneath the scene. The lines are finely detailed and colored with a subtle, yet colorful palette, capturing the ornate beauty and drama inherent in such historical events.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback engaging in a jousting match. The scene captures the moment where both lances have shattered upon impact. The horses are adorned with elaborate caparisons—one predominantly in red and white, the other in shades of green. The riders are in full armor, with their armor designs reflecting a historical style. The detail in the drawing highlights the movement and energy of the scene, with the action centered around the breaking lances and the postures of the horses and riders. The paper shows signs of age, with text written at the top and some spots, adding to the historic appeal.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a jousting scene with fallen horses and knights. The image depicts two armored knights and their horses lying on the ground, seemingly having fallen from a jousting match. The knights are dressed in detailed, ornate armor and vivid clothing, predominantly in blues, reds, and whites, with plumes and exaggerated styles characteristic of renaissance tournaments. The horses are also dressed in matching caparisons, and one can see the lance or jousting pole extending across the image. The illustration includes faint textural marks and a script in the upper right corner, resembling a medieval manuscript illustration.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval jousting scene. Two horses in the painting, covered in fabric and armor, demonstrate movement suggesting a jousting match. The horse on the left is depicted in motion, with a rider in matching striped armor in shades of green, brown, and cream. The rider is holding a long lance pointed towards the opponent. The horse on the right also has a decorative and protective covering, its rider appears to be unseated. The overall composition emphasizes the motion and drama of medieval tournaments. The intricate detailing of the fabric and armor gives the scene a classic, historical aesthetic. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fallen armoured horses. The image depicts two horses lying on their sides, draped in ornate caparisons. One horse is black with red and white trim, while the other is yellow with blue accents. There are broken lances on the ground around them. Clad legs are visible in armor, indicating unseated riders from a jousting match. The background is plain, and the drawing is detailed with precise lines and color washes. A note with text is in the upper left corner of the page.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace

One rider is tilted backward with legs upturned, while the other remains seated. The horses and riders are adorned in colorful attire. The scene is bordered by lines and includes handwritten text at the top, indicating its origin as part of a larger narrative or document.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene between two mounted knights. The drawing depicts knights in armor on horses engaged in a jousting match. Each knight features an armor design and carries a lance. The horses are also armored and decorated to match the knights. The image captures a dynamic moment of a jousting duel.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures and horses in a jousting scene. The image shows two knights lying on the ground with their fallen horses. One knight wears blue and white armor with red leggings, while the other wears blue and white armor with a checkered pattern of green and brown. The horses are covered in caparisons of different colors and lay tangled amidst the fallen knights. Broken lances are scattered on the ground. There is a number "19" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval jousting scene. The image shows two armored horses engaged in a jousting match. The horse on the left has lost its rider, as the armor-clad figure is depicted falling backwards. The horses are adorned in decorative blankets; the one on the left has a green and blue color scheme, and the one on the right has a red and green pattern. Broken lances are visible in mid-air crossing in an X-formation. The drawing captures the dynamic moment of competition, with attention to the varying patterns and colors on the robes and armor.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene with two figures on horseback. The lances of both opponents have broken in mid-air during impact. The figures are clad in armor, and their horses have colorful caparisons. The left figure's horse has a black and red checkered cloth and the rider's helmet features a crest with a plume. The right figure has their head thrown back and wears a helmet with a closed visor. The broken lance pieces are scattered in the air. The drawing conveys the intensity and suddenness of a jousting tournament. Handwritten text is present above and below the scene.

artworks.title: Mixed Jousts of War and Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored horses and riders engaged in a jousting competition. The drawing shows two knights in full armor, mounted on horses, charging towards each other with lances. Both horses are richly decorated, with one horse’s barding featuring green and white stripes and the other in a more modest pattern. The knights’ armor is intricately detailed, and helmets are adorned with plumes and crests. The moment captured shows the jousting lances meeting in the center. The background is blank, focusing attention on the encounter. The minimal use of color highlights the knights' armor and the horses' decoration, providing a sense of motion and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two knights engaged in a jousting match. The illustration depicts two armored figures on horseback, each wielding a lance. One knight appears to have been struck and is falling from his horse. The lance of the opponent has pierced his armor. The horses are elaborately dressed, with decorative cloth and armor. The colors are varied, with earthy tones and vibrant highlights. Fine details, such as the plume on the helmets and the intricate pattern on the armor and horses' coverings, contribute to the authenticity of the artwork.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace in High Saddles

artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures engaged in a jousting tournament. The figures are mounted on horses adorned in cloth coverings that correspond to their riders' outfits. The rider on the left is in vibrant red and gray stripes, while the rider on the right is in green and blue. Both riders are holding lances. The horses are depicted in mid-stride. The background is left blank. Above and below the jousting scene are sections of handwritten script.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace

The drawing depicts a humorous or whimsical scene where the horses are adorned in elaborate caparisoning and medieval-style horse armor. The horses are side by side, and both the horses and riders are depicted in vibrant colors, featuring hues of yellow, blue, red, and green.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored horse with fallen riders. There are two armored figures slumped over the horse, dressed in red and green armor. A broken jousting lance is visible, along with other scattered fragments on the ground.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armored knights engaged in a jousting match. The painting depicts a scene where one knight, dressed in silver armor with accents of red, is mounted on a brown horse that is rearing up on its hind legs. The opposite knight is seen falling backwards off his horse, clad in a green robe and armor. The image illustrates the moment of impact with lances in the air, one of which has struck the green knight. The horses are depicted with detailed trappings and expressions, and the overall scene is dynamically presented. The use of watercolor and careful line work adds to the tension and movement of the image. This is in the style of Hans Burgkmair.

artworks.title: German Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two armored figures jousting on horseback. Both knights are engaged in a dynamic joust, each in full armor and mounted on horses with decorative caparisons. One knight appears to be falling backward, possibly unseated by the impact of the opponent’s lance, which is visibly bent. The horses have different-colored draped cloths – one is dark brown, and the other is golden with intricate designs. The knights wear typical medieval armor and helmets.

artworks.title: Joust of Peace in Leg Armor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures on horseback. The drawing depicts two knights in full armor, both mounted on horses, in what appears to be a moment of contact or a jousting match. The knight on the left is clad in a green and intricately patterned armor, with their horse adorned in matching green barding. The knight on the right wears armor and is draped in a contrasting striped pattern of a dark shade. The poses of the knights and horses suggest action and movement, as though captured mid-clash. The drawing's details emphasize medieval armor and textiles.
